response.sql: WITH per_equip AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM per_equip), kept AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_hum, o.overall_avg FROM per_equip p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_hum > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, k.avg_hum - k.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall_avg, k.avg_hum - m.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Equipment whose humidity readings are all NULL have a NULL average. They are excluded from the all-equipment average and cannot pass the 'above average' filter.
The 'all-equipment average' is the unweighted mean of the per-equipment averages, not the mean of all raw readings.
The 'kept-equipment mean' is the unweighted mean of the kept equipment's averages.
Equipment is grouped by scanenvironment.equipref without joining to the equipment table.
